label: FIXTURE RESULT: Stage 5 evaluation (recorded window, frozen bundle)

attempts.validity: all complete True, pending max 5.0, failures 0, server errors 0.0, pool timeouts 0, other edges 0

report.summary: In-window delivery is healthy (~71 ms, all succeed). A stuck backlog of 296 FAILED outbox rows, oldest ~6,500 s old, is the likely source of late notifications; why they failed is not shown.

findings.claim: New transfers are published promptly: 732 arrivals vs 731 publications, all deliveries succeeded with ~71 ms latency.
findings.reason: Arrivals and publications match per bucket; 731/731 SUCCESS, p95 72 ms, consumer handler time negligible.

findings.claim: 296 outbox rows sit in FAILED state, unchanged through the whole window, and the oldest undelivered item is ~6,525-6,730 s old and growing.
findings.reason: failed stayed at 296 (min=max) and oldest_undelivered_age rose steadily by about the elapsed time.

findings.claim: Late notifications likely come from older events that exhausted retries (maxAttempts=8) and are never retried, not from current throughput, DB or pool problems.
findings.reason: No failed attempts in the window, no pool waits or DB blocking, no 5xx; a static FAILED set with a growing age fits dead-lettered rows.

limitations: Delivery logs cover only this window; the attempts that produced the 296 FAILED rows are not included.
Pending is a sampled gauge, and blocking is sampled every 2 s, so brief events could be missed.
next_checks: Inspect the 296 FAILED outbox rows (last error, attempt counts, creation times) and logs from when they failed.
Check whether the affected customers' notifications correspond to those FAILED rows, then requeue them if safe.

alternatives.reason: The window has no failures, so the original failure cause and time are not visible.
alternatives.hypothesis: A past consumer or network outage caused the failures and has since recovered.

alternatives.reason: No pool pending or timeouts, and no blocking sessions sampled.
alternatives.hypothesis: Database or pool contention delays publication.

A.rule: no failed deliveries and pending stayed low
